description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all nonland cards in your library.
Cast Demonlord Belzenlok by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Demonlord Belzenlok enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the remainder of your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to mill two cards and win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
